message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday, or is observed on the following Monday when it lands on a weekend.)

| Date(s) | Holiday | Day of Week | Provinces/territories that observe it | Long‑weekend status |
|---------|---------|-------------|--------------------------------------|---------------------|
| **Jan 1–3** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon Feb 2 if on weekend) | Sun Jan 1 / Mon Jan 2 | All provinces & territories | Yes (Sun–Mon) |
| **Feb 18–20** | Family Day (BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, NB, PE) | Mon Feb 20 | BC, AB, SK, MB, ON, NB, PE | Yes (Mon) |
| **Mar 17** | St. Patrick’s Day (ON) | Fri Mar 17 | Ontario | Yes (Fri) |
| **Apr 7–9** | Good Friday (all) | Fri Apr 7 | All | Yes (Fri) |
| **Apr 23** | St. George’s Day (BC) | Fri Apr 23 | British Columbia | Yes (Fri) |
| **May 25–27** | Victoria Day (all) | Mon May 25 | All | Yes (Mon) |
| **Jul 1–3** | Canada Day (all) | Sat Jul 1 | All | Yes (Sat) |
| **Sep 1–3** | Labour Day (all) | Mon Sep 1 | All | Yes (Mon) |
| **Oct 9–11** | Thanksgiving (all) | Mon Oct 9 | All | Yes (Mon) |
| **Nov 11–13** | Remembrance Day (all) | Sat Nov 11 | All | Yes (Sat) |
| **Dec 25–27** | Christmas Day (all) | Mon Dec 25 | All | Yes (Mon) |
| **Dec 26–28** | Boxing Day (all) | Tue Dec 26 | All | No (Tue) |

### Quick notes

* **Observance rules** – If a holiday falls on a weekend, most provinces observe it on the following Monday (e.g., New Year’s Day 2023 fell on Sunday, so it was observed on Monday, Jan 2).  
* **Province‑specific holidays** – The table above lists only the holidays that create long weekends nationwide or in multiple provinces.  
  * Ontario has **St. Patrick’s Day** (Mar 17).  
  * British Columbia has **St. George’s Day** (Apr 23).  
  * Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, and Prince Edward Island also observe **Family Day** (Feb 20).  
  * Nova Scotia observes **St. Andrew’s Day** (Nov 30) – a long weekend for that province only.  
* **Other holidays** – Some provinces have additional statutory holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. George’s Day in BC, St. Andrew’s Day in NS) that may create a long weekend for residents of those provinces.

Feel free to copy the table into your holiday‑planning app or adapt it to the specific provinces you’re targeting. If you need a more granular, province‑by‑province breakdown or the exact dates for a different year, let me know!
